SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ............
S. I, Special Branch ......... Shanghai
REPORT
Date .... Nov .... 11, .... 19 37 .

Subject (in full) .... Hwa Tung Radio Broadcasting Station - warned
against broadcasting anti-Japanese plays.

Made by ................ and ................ Forwarded by .... D.I. Crawford

Mr. Woo Chuek-sun (胡菊), representative
of the Manager, Mr. Li Tsung-ts (李震之), of the Hwa
Tung Radio Broadcasting Station, 465 Kwangse Road, was
interviewed at Police Headquarters at 10 a.m. November 11,
when he was warned against broadcasting songs and plays
of an objectionable nature. Mr. Woo stated that the
programme mentioned in the attached report was broadcasted
by the Cultural Circles Race Salvation Association, and
was suspended the day after the broadcast. He promised
to comply with the Police instructions and in future
would submit all programmes for examination to this
Branch before broadcasting.

C. Crawford
cp.    D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch)

（印：S.B. 11 NOV 1937）

S. I，特别支部  ____  上海
报告
日期  ____  11月 ____  11日， ____  1937年。

主题（全称）  ____  华通广播电台 - 被警告不得播送反日剧目。

制作人  ____  和  ____  转呈人  ____  副督察长克劳福德 (Crawford)

华通广播电台经理李震之 (Li Tsung-ts) 的代表胡菊 (Woo Chuek-sun)，于11月11日上午10时在警察总局接受问询，期间被告诫不得播送性质不当的歌曲和剧目。胡先生称，附件报告中所提及的节目是由文化界救亡协会播送的，且在播送次日即已停播。他承诺遵守警方指示，今后将在播送前将所有节目提交本支部审查。

C. 克劳福德 (Crawford)
抄送    副督察长
D. C. （特别支部）

（印：特别支部 1937年11月11日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.I, Special Branch [手写签名]
REPORT
Date Nov. 10, 1937.

Subject Hwa Tung Broadcasting Station - broadcasts patriotic
play.

Made by Clerk Wong Chia-tsing Forwarded by C. Crawford [手写签名]

Between 2 p.m. and 2.30 p.m. November 9, 1937,
the Hwa Tung Radio Broadcasting Station, wave length
1,360 k.c., 465 Kwangse Road, broadcasted a play, briefly
as follows :-

On the eve of the anniversary of the Mukden
Incident (September 18 anniversary), there lived in a
certain city in the Three Eastern Provinces a family
consisting of a husband and wife, who were members of the
volunteer army. They kept a bomb in their home. Two
Japanese soldiers came in and searched their house. They
were shot by the male occupant, who at the same time threw
the bomb. The explosion of the bomb served as a signal
given to the volunteer army outside the city to attack the
city.

It is to be noted that this drama appears to be
the one entitled "Alarm" or "A bomb", which was previously
banned by the Municipal Police.

Wong Chia Tsing
Clerk

报告
日期 1937年11月10日。

主题 华通广播电台 - 播送爱国剧目。

制作人 书记员黄家清 (Wong Chia-tsing) 转呈人 C. 克劳福德 (Crawford) [手写签名]

1937年11月9日下午2时至2时30分之间，位于光西路465号、波长1,360千周的华通广播电台播送了一出剧目，简要内容如下：

在“九一八”事变（九月十八日纪念日）前夕，东北三省某城市居住着一对夫妇，二人均为义勇军成员。他们在家中藏有一枚炸弹。两名日本士兵进入并搜查其住所。男主人开枪射击，同时投掷炸弹。炸弹爆炸作为信号，通知城外的义勇军进攻该城。

值得注意的是，此剧似乎即为此前被工部局警务处禁播的名为《警报》或《一枚炸弹》的剧目。

黄家清 (Wong Chia Tsing)
书记员

November 7, 1937.                                      Morning Translation.

Chiu Huang Jih Pao (救亡日報) :-

        TO-DAY'S BROADCASTING PROGRAMME

            At 2 p.m. to-day the Hwa Tung Radio Broadcasting
station will broadcast a play entitled "Let Us be One-
Minded" (大家一條心).
            At 7 p.m. to-day the Great China Dispensary
Radio Station will broadcast a play entitled "Fighting at
Lotien" (血戰羅店), and several songs including one
entitled "Protect Greater Shanghai" (保衛大上海).
            At 2 p.m. to-day the Shanghai City Government
Radi. Station will broadcast a play entitled "Protect
the Motherland" (保衛家鄉).

1937年11月7日。                                      晨间翻译。

《救亡日报》：

        今日广播节目

            今日下午2时，华通广播电台将播送一出名为《大家一条心》的剧目。
            今日晚上7时，大中华大药房广播电台将播送一出名为《血战罗店》的剧目，以及数首歌曲，其中包括一首名为《保卫大上海》的歌曲。
            今日下午2时，上海市政府广播电台将播送一出名为《保卫家乡》的剧目。
